---
name: Integration report
about: You connected Granum Grid to your own data. Tell us what got in the way.
title: 'Integration report: '
labels: integration-report
---

**Your data.** What rows, roughly how many, and where they live (API, database, file).

**How you connected it.** `createArrayProvider`, `createCursorProvider`, the Parquet adapter, or your own `DataProvider`. Link the code if you can.

**What you rendered.** The three-prop component, regions you turned on (`toolbar`, `footer`, `header`), the widgets, or the headless hook.

**What got in the way.** Each thing that took longer than it should have, in the order you hit it: what you tried, what happened, and what you did instead.

**What you would remove.** Anything you had to turn off or work around.

**Versions.** `granum-grid`, React, bundler, and browser.
